authorisation: Create locally, review, publish after required checks.
constructionGate: Existing module/stage map, B02 four units/20lesson blueprint, U04–U07 completed teaching and six separate assessment hours. No scope change.

questions.title: A pull changes the contact
questions.scope: Own force diagram/third-law partner; angled pull normal and static condition; changed pull kinetic acceleration; independent constant-force work/energy check.

questions.title: Which distance belongs in an orbit?
questions.scope: Circular gravitational model derivation, centre radius versus altitude, field/speed/period, mass doubling and freefall explanation. No orbital-energy integration.

questions.title: Two checks on one collision
questions.scope: Signed momentum and two candidate reports; kinetic-energy consistency versus passive assumption; impulses/average forces; interval-bound and system explanation.

questions.title: An energy account for a thermal assembly
questions.scope: Three-body balance; changed measured endpoint with paddle work; level/interval and transfer distinction; controlled follow-up differentiating thermal loss versus probe offset.

questions.title: Does the motion require changing acceleration?
questions.scope: Polynomial rates and finite-step hand check; independent CSV/model functions/common comparisons; position and residual plots/MAR; fresh rerun and independent benchmarks; bounded conclusion and one next observation.

privateKey: Detailed checked solutions and specimen code outside public repository in sibling work/p101-tma02-private. Public criteria, no solutions/reveal controls.
handover: After U07 and formative iCMA02, before B03 U08 outline; M101U05 derivative prerequisite already explicit in U07. Earlier P101 Python and evidence methods cumulative.
media: Two original scenario diagrams and one full source table. Students draw assessed free-body/model/residual graphs. Assessment-format calibration against P101TMA01 avoids supplying an assessed answer as illustration; no decorative photo or interactive answer calculator.
data: Original invented record, transparently identified; same-time independent runs remain distinct. No claim to experimental validation or invented instrument specification.
workload: Editorial estimate, not learner timing trial. Existing feedback allocation used for subsequent feedback; any targeted reassessment requires a separately agreed scope/time, not automatic six-hour repeat.
